questions.question: Why does Good Night Hotel in Ahmedabad have no usable current price?
questions.reply: Hotel Good Night in Ahmedabad shows a **null price** because the system has no current rate available. The record only contains a historical tariff (INR 1,700 per night, February 2014) and notes that the price is “unavailable — check current rates.” Therefore, the app cannot provide a usable, up‑to‑date price.
